decoder.name: identity-lab-login
decoder.regex: LOGIN_ATTEMPT timestamp=(\S+ \S+) user=(\S+) role=(\S+) ip=(\S+) device="(\.+)" result=(\S+)
decoder.order: timestamp, user, role, srcip, extra_data, result

decoder.name: identity-lab-rolechange
decoder.regex: ROLE_CHANGE timestamp=(\S+ \S+) actor=(\S+) ip=(\S+) target=(\S+) old_role=(\S+) new_role=(\S+) result=(\S+)
decoder.order: timestamp, user, srcip, target_user, old_role, new_role, result

decoder.name: identity-lab-mfa
decoder.regex: MFA_EVENT timestamp=(\S+ \S+) user=(\S+) role=(\S+) ip=(\S+) device="(\.+)" action=(\S+) result=(\S+)
decoder.order: timestamp, user, role, srcip, extra_data, status, result
